per_article_summaries: Max Verstappen says he would rather have started from the pitlane. The Red Bull driver was on course for his third podium finish of the season. But he spun off at high speed through Stowe in the closing stages of the race. Verstappen calls Red Bull's rear wing issues "dangerous"

MotoGP race at Circuit Ricardo Tormo takes place on Sunday. Sebastian Vettel will start on the front row of the grid for the first time this season. The Spaniard will be joined by team-mate Felipe Massa in the paddock.

Kimi Antonelli's five-race winning streak ended at Silverstone. George Russell's bad luck excuse no longer works. Red Bull's power unit is still a weakness at energy-starved circuits. Lewis Hamilton's win at Silverstone was exactly the boost Charles Leclerc needed.

FIA summons Lewis Hamilton and Ferrari team representative to explain a potential breach of Formula 1 yellow flag regulations. Hamilton was required to appear before the stewards immediately after the podium ceremony, at 5:00pm BST. The Ferrari driver admitted that he expects to lose his British GP podium finish as a result of it.

Ferrari's Charles Leclerc wins British Grand Prix at Silverstone. Team-mate Kimi Antonelli loses second place to Lewis Hamilton. Red Bull's Max Verstappen spun off the road with six laps to go. Hamilton takes five-second time penalty for false start.

Kimi Antonelli has won five of the opening nine races of the Formula 1 season. George Russell finished second in the British Grand Prix at Silverstone. The Briton is 25 points adrift of his Mercedes team-mate in the championship.

Mercedes will not contest Kimi Antonelli's five-second penalty in the British GP. The championship leader finished outside the points at Silverstone. Toto Wolff suggested the team would be looking into trying to get Antonelli's penalty rescinded.

Lewis Hamilton was investigated by the FIA race stewards for allegedly speeding. Hamilton entered the yellow sector before the yellow flag was displayed and only received a warning on his dashboard at the end of it. The stewards accepted that the seven-time world champion only had little time to react to the yellows. As he didn't reduce speed they still handed him a reprimand.

The 2026 British Grand Prix at Silverstone ended under safety car conditions. The safety car was deployed on lap 48 after Max Verstappen spun out and into the gravel at Stowe in front of the Landostand. Mercedes' George Russell stayed out and took second position. As the chequered flag drew closer, the lapped cars were instructed to unlap themselves.

The safety car was initially called in for a final-lap shootout before the decision was reversed. Max Verstappen crashed with six laps to go, which triggered a frantic finish to the Silverstone race. Charles Leclerc took victory without a final-lap fight despite pitting for fresh soft tyres in preparation for a restart.

Kimi Antonelli left Silverstone empty-handed after suffering a mechanical failure. The Italian was chasing down Ferrari's Charles Leclerc when an aerodynamic component on the front-left corner of his car broke. Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff revealed the team's simulations suggested Antonelli would have caught Leclerc.
